description: Defines the QuicTcpLikeTraceConverter class for converting sent QUIC frames to connection byte offsets, similar to TCP sequence numbers.

classes.name: QuicTcpLikeTraceConverter
classes.description: A class that converts sent QUIC frames into connection byte offsets, maintaining stream segments and control frame info.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrameSent
methods.description: Returns connection offsets when a crypto frame is sent.

methods.name: OnStreamFrameSent
methods.description: Returns connection offsets when a stream frame is sent.

methods.name: OnControlFrameSent
methods.description: Returns connection offsets when a control frame is sent.
